title: Procurement Fund for Infrastructure Assets
body:
## Procurement Fund proposal for securing Infrastructure Assets
April 4/6/2022


![](https://commonwealth-uploads.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/1f9159d3-9e6c-4c39-88c2-bbccd4e9c869.1649283730690)

**GOAL:**

      The purpose of this proposal is a Procurement Fund for securing Infrastructure Assets. Requesting $11,500 in EDG (market equivalent) for continued investment of the diversification of assets (TVL).

**EXPERIENCE: ZOVERN**

	10+ Year background in Information Technology. Prior position was IT Manager for 4+ years responsible for Project Management, Inventory/Asset Management, Troubleshooting and Training. Currently performing Data Science for Executive Reporting of productivity metrics for the IT department servicing a network of Hospitals supporting 100,000+ employees. 

**STRATEGY:**

	This Procurement fund for Infrastructure Assets. It's backed by strong market research and supplemental quantitative analysis. Each asset considered, may have a fundamental role in future development in community services and community networking. Storage Assets provide an immediate additional resource. Networking assets provides a bridge and strengthens our position within the crypto ecosystem. The selected crypto assets are considered low risk as their functions as utility are currently applicable. Diversified in each domain, asset selection was based on consensus. Value Investing at its core.
